v01: Every GitHub repository is a city.
You just haven't seen it yet.
v03: Folders become districts, and files become buildings.
The tallest towers are the files that matter most.
v04: Every open issue is out on the street.
Bugs are crashes, blocked work is a roadblock.
Click one, and you get the real issue,
and why it looks the way it does.
v05: Open pull requests are building sites,
with scaffolding on the files they change.
v06: It even works the night shift.
v07: A small library is a village.
v08: with five hundred open pull requests on its streets.
v09: Press Tour, and the city tells you its own story.
